findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler but only contains pass, failing to implement its requir
findings.description: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler but only contains pass, failing to implement its required abstract methods: counter_names (property), get_dedupe_value(), get_group_key_values(), and build_occurrence_and_event_data(). This will cause a TypeError at runtime when the class is instantiated.
